handoffs.message: Ready for review: B2 broker live activation criteria JSON and fail-closed validator merged via PR #245. Implementation commit 2e8c8a9c, merge commit 7f914982. Verified locally with pytest -q tests/broker/test_live_activation_validator.py (5 passed), python3 -m py_compile services/broker/live_activation/validator.py services/broker/live_activation/__init__.py, and python3 -m json.tool services/broker/live_activation/criteria.json.

Review changes requested: fail-closed criteria handling needs correction. validate_criteria_shape({}) currently falls back to default criteria and passes, while validate_activation_request(..., criteria={'version':'bad'} or missing required_evidence) raises TypeError instead of returning a blocking ValidationResult. Please treat only None as default criteria, make explicit empty/invalid criteria fail closed with validation issues, and add regression coverage before re-handoff.

Re-handoff after fail-closed criteria fix. PR #251 pushed at 447d1a2f; validate_criteria_shape({}) now blocks instead of defaulting, invalid activation criteria return ValidationResult errors before evidence checks, and pytest tests/broker passes.

Review approved by Codex2. Verified fail-closed criteria handling and broker validator tests: pytest -q tests/broker/test_live_activation_validator.py and pytest -q tests/broker both passed (8 passed). PR #251 is already merged into dev at f0207b3f; owner should run closeout finalization and mark done.
